_doc: Head-phantom geometry for the API source mode — BGO ring at 2 radiation lengths. Same transverse layout as crysp_ring_1m (r_inner, n_phi, n_z, half_length); wall = 2 X0 of BGO (X0 = 1.118 cm -> 2.236 cm; the CRYSP 3.5 mm FWHM position resolution is measured on 2X0 crystals). Shared by BGO_195K and BGO_77K (same density, same X0; the config's [transport].crystal_material picks the temperature). The phantom section is a PLACEHOLDER — in mode="api" the driver replaces it with the phantom built from the scenario's phantom_regions.csv. Dimensions in cm; material keys into data/materials.json.
